title: Tap Out or Go Home
flavorText: The truest test of a technical wrestler is not how hard you can hit — it's how long your opponent can hold on. Make them tap.
setupInstructions: Standard setup, any wrestlers. Apply the Submission segment rule.
conditions: No pinfalls — submission is the only victory condition.

title: Say Those Two Words!
flavorText: You can take all the punishment in the world. But once you say those two words... it's over. Make sure it's THEM saying it.
objective: Win an I Quit match without using any Recovery action.
setupInstructions: Standard setup, any wrestlers. Apply the I Quit Match segment rule.
conditions: You may not play any Recovery action cards for the duration of the match.

title: Climb Every Mountain
flavorText: The gold hangs above the ring. All you have to do is climb. Everyone else in the match has exactly the same idea.
objective: Win a Ladder match. Your wrestler starts with 5 fewer Stamina than normal.
setupInstructions: Standard setup, any wrestlers. Apply the Ladder Match segment rule. Reduce your starting Stamina by 5 before the match begins.

title: Rest in Pieces
flavorText: The lid creaks. The darkness calls. The only thing between your opponent and the casket... is you.
objective: Win a Casket match after your Health has been reduced to 5 or lower at some point.
setupInstructions: Standard setup, any wrestlers. Apply the Casket Match segment rule.
conditions: The win only counts if your Health reached 5 or lower at some point during the match.

title: Everything and the Kitchen Sink
flavorText: Tables. Ladders. Chairs. The holy trinity of mayhem. Welcome to the most dangerous arena in custom content.
objective: Win a TLC match without using chair-based abilities until your opponent is below 50% Health.
setupInstructions: Standard setup, any wrestlers. Apply the Tables, Ladders and Chairs (TLC) segment rule.
conditions: You may not play chair-based ability cards until your opponent has less than 50% Health remaining.

title: Last One Left
flavorText: One by one they'll fall. Pinfall. Submission. It doesn't matter how — what matters is that you're the last one standing.
objective: Win a 3-way Elimination match without being eliminated at any point.
setupInstructions: 3-way Elimination match, standard setup. Apply the Elimination segment rule.
conditions: If you are pinned or submitted at any point, the win does not count for this challenge.

title: Gauntlet of Legends
flavorText: One after another they keep coming. Each opponent fresher than the last. Only the most durable champions survive.
objective: Win a 4-opponent Gauntlet starting at 50% Stamina. No Taunts between matches.
setupInstructions: 4-opponent Gauntlet, standard setup. Apply the Gauntlet segment rule. Reduce your starting Stamina by half (round down) before the first match.
conditions: No Taunt actions may be used between matches.

title: The Match Beyond
flavorText: Two rings. One cage. Eight warriors. Once everyone is in, it's no longer about tactics. It's about survival.
objective: Win a War Games match as the team that enters the cage second.
setupInstructions: Standard War Games setup. Apply the War Games segment rule. Your team enters the cage second, giving the opposing team one extra entrant before 'The Match Beyond' phase begins.
conditions: Opposing team has one more entrant before the final phase.
